methodology.fixed_quality_reference: 0.6.4 audit helpers applied to all plans; canonical foreground masks additionally used only for generated glyph-like fixtures with known black intent.
methodology.literal_coverage: Quantized top layer satin/fill/running, nominal0.3mm thread footprint; excludes underlay, travel and locks. Computational opacity, not textile opacity.
methodology.structural_coverage: Separate 0.25mm geometric tolerance. High structural coverage does not prove literal per-colour or omitted-detail fidelity.
methodology.equivalence: Compare emitted methods and transformed directions within matched geometric cohorts, not just displayed labels.
methodology.counter_oracle: Known negative space per source colour; measurable deep cores eroded by0.4mm. Tiny/empty cores are not certified.
methodology.performance: Independent sequential generation, one warmup and three measures per fresh case/reference process; no tests, builds or other project generations during timing. Shared workstation observations, not causal speedups.
methodology.method_units: methods counts source-region decisions; top_blocks and stats.satin_regions count emitted fragments, not letters.
